title: Storage Rental Product Catalogue — Unit Dimensions and Features
content:
Larkspur offers six Storage Rental products, each an on-site space rented month to month as an add-on to an Apartment Home Lease. The physical specification of each product is fixed per product and is the same for every unit of that product.

## Size

| Storage Rental product | Interior width (ft) | Interior depth (ft) | Floor area (sq ft) | Clear ceiling height (ft) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bike Storage Locker | 2.00 | 6.00 | 12 | 4.00 |
| Small Storage Closet (4x4) | 4.00 | 4.00 | 16 | 8.00 |
| Standard Storage Unit (5x5) | 5.00 | 5.00 | 25 | 8.00 |
| Large Storage Unit (5x10) | 5.00 | 10.00 | 50 | 8.00 |
| Climate-Controlled Storage Unit (5x10) | 5.00 | 10.00 | 50 | 8.00 |
| Oversized Storage Suite (10x10) | 10.00 | 10.00 | 100 | 9.00 |

## Location, door and environment

| Storage Rental product | Location | Opens onto an interior corridor | Door | Climate controlled (held between 55 and 80 degrees Fahrenheit) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bike Storage Locker | Bike room | No | Mesh locker | No |
| Small Storage Closet (4x4) | Interior corridor | Yes | Swing door | No |
| Standard Storage Unit (5x5) | Garage level | No | Swing door | No |
| Large Storage Unit (5x10) | Garage level | No | Roll-up door | No |
| Climate-Controlled Storage Unit (5x10) | Interior corridor | Yes | Swing door | Yes |
| Oversized Storage Suite (10x10) | Garage level | No | Roll-up door | No |

A unit that does not open onto an interior corridor is reached from a garage aisle or from the exterior.

## Fittings and load

| Storage Rental product | 120-volt outlet | Fixed shelving installed | Bicycles held | Maximum floor load (lb per sq ft) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bike Storage Locker | No | No | 2 | 50 |
| Small Storage Closet (4x4) | No | Yes | 0 | 50 |
| Standard Storage Unit (5x5) | No | No | 0 | 100 |
| Large Storage Unit (5x10) | No | No | 0 | 100 |
| Climate-Controlled Storage Unit (5x10) | No | Yes | 0 | 50 |
| Oversized Storage Suite (10x10) | Yes | No | 0 | 125 |

The bicycle count is 0 for every product that is not a bike locker.

## Reading the catalogue

- **Same footprint, different product.** The Large Storage Unit (5x10) and the Climate-Controlled Storage Unit (5x10) both measure 5.00 by 10.00 feet with 50 square feet of floor and 8.00 feet of clear height; they differ in climate control, corridor access, door, shelving and floor load, as the tables show.
- **Temperature-held space.** Of the six Storage Rental products, only the Climate-Controlled Storage Unit (5x10) is held between 55 and 80 degrees Fahrenheit.
- **Power.** Only the Oversized Storage Suite (10x10) has a 120-volt outlet.
- **Tallest clear height.** The Oversized Storage Suite (10x10) has 9.00 feet of clear height; the Bike Storage Locker has 4.00 feet; the other four products have 8.00 feet.
